direction: E8: Offline Skill prior from the archives (warm start)
refuted_claims:
1. Claims: "the deepseek serving changed behaviour between about 2026-10-20 02:00 and 16:00 ... since roughly the afternoon of 2026-10-20, the serving writes visible working by default", "The failures this warm start was distilled from came from a solver behaviour that no longer exists" and "New project-level finding".
   - Checked: I re-binned the v3 train cells and the s1-screen parent cells by time (v3_style.py, v3_screen_style.py on the new machine's read-only v3 copy; no evaluation directory opened) and read D5's session table.
   - Found: the route switches back and forth between a terse mode (bare <answer> tag) and a verbose mode (working written out).
     - Verbose, 10-19 23:20: v3 I-ds SearchQA s1 train, 7.7% bare, median 62 tokens.
     - Terse, 10-20 00:00-01:15: E-ds s1 train 86.5% bare; I-ds s1 screen parent 80-92% bare; E-ds s1 screen parent at 01:00-01:15 85%/64% bare.
     - Verbose, 01:30-02:00: E-ds screen parent 10-16% bare, median about 40.
     - Terse again: OfficeQA s2 train at 01:00 (I-ds, 79.7% bare) and 02:00 (E-ds, 90.5% bare); D5 reports terse 02:28-06:35.
     - Verbose from 15:59 onwards: E8 itself had the scaffold 6-33% bare in every 10-minute bin.
   - So the terse mode recurs; it is not extinct. The finding is not new either: D5 already reported "session-to-session serving drift". The explorer's own "v3 I-ds -> cal-1, median 62 -> 61, no change" row exists because that session was already verbose, which contradicts the single-switch timing.
   - The remedies "re-measure the same week" and "forbid cross-day comparisons" have the wrong granularity. The unit is the session or interleaved block, with the bare share recorded per cell.
   - Minor: v3 ran on the OLD machine (the new copy has whole-second mtimes) and E8 on the NEW one, so the OfficeQA drift pair also crosses machines. A machine effect is unlikely, because E8's SearchQA scaffold median (40) matches cal-1's (41, old machine).

2. Claim: "Comparisons within E8 are unaffected, because all arms were interleaved in one window."
   - True for bias. But the effects themselves depend on the mode, and E8 sampled only the verbose mode.
   - The scaffold drops the tag in verbose sessions: 29/200 untagged in E8, against 4/400 for the same scaffold in the terse v3 E-ds s1 train (I-ds 3/400). So D's -13.5-point loss under the card's metric is not a stable property of the rules.
   - On OfficeQA, D's harm runs through bare answers. In terse sessions every arm answers bare anyway (v3: 80-90% bare, 20-26% pass), so the gap may shrink.
   - "D < I" is established for verbose sessions only.

3. Claim: the pilot mechanism "dropped answer tags (32/200)" attributed to the distilled Skill.
   - Found: the same-session scaffold without rules (E) gave 29/200 untagged replies, so the rules add about 3 untagged replies.
   - The D-vs-I gap under the tag rule is the missing seed format bullets (I 0/200), not harm from the rules. The comparison attributable to the rules is D-E = +0.015 [-0.070, +0.100] (18/16).
   - D's untagged replies are mostly correct bare answers (27/32 pass via fallback, e.g. "antiperspirant", "Lord Robert Baden-Powell."). E's are mostly wrong (3/29).

4. Claims: the headline "measured, not worth it" and "Do not adopt an archive-distilled warm start".
   - What was measured is D = scaffold + rules REPLACING the card. The owner's yardstick, and the project's standing question (v8-v11: clauses on top of a good instruction, +3 to +5, not significant), needs ID = card + rules against I. That arm was prepared but not run.
   - The evidence supports "distilled rules cannot replace the card", not "a warm start is not worth it". Recommendation 2 concedes this; the title and verdict_cn do not.

5. Claims: "Serves purpose 1 (what is learnable from experience)" and the purpose-2 statement "a prior that fails this cannot be expected to carry across benchmarks".
   - Purpose 1 is the co-evolution of the Skill AND the verifier's coding rubric. E8 has no verifier side and no evolution (one offline pass); at most it is a Skill initialiser.
   - Purpose 2 (evolve on one benchmark, evaluate on the others) was never measured. Each benchmark's rules sit in their own "Applies when" section and were scored only on their own benchmark.
   - E4 shows that cross-benchmark effects are dominated by answer-format conflicts (-20 to -27 points on OfficeQA). That is a different mechanism, so within-benchmark results are no measurement of transfer.

6. Claim: recommendation 3, "Use the archives as a 'known proposal families' list, so the analyst does not re-propose them (E8 re-discovered v3's rejected families)".
   - Checked rules_analysis.json: for 4 of the 14 kept rules, the closest v3 proposal was voided as evidence_invalid and never measured. The others died where 14/15 screened rules failed C1 under a noise floor larger than any rule effect.
   - "Never accepted" does not mean "shown useless"; blacklisting would freeze underpowered verdicts.
   - The median containment of 0.355 partly reflects shared evidence vocabulary (both were written from the same diagnosed failures), so "closely re-discover" overstates.

7. Claim: "run the prepared seeds+rules arm on SearchQA first (about 1.7M tokens). It directly answers whether distilled rules add anything on top of the card."
   - Checked scripts2/e8_arm_id.py: arms I and ID only, the same 100 items, 2 runs, no placebo.
   - D-I was discordant on 5/100 items, and instructed arms flip on 1/100 between runs. So ID-I will likely have at most 5 discordant items, while any sign-test p < 0.05 needs at least 6.
   - D9 puts the headroom above the card at 0-3 points, below the 5.3-point detectable effect.
   - The cal-1 placebos alone moved the scaffold by -9.8 to +3.6 points, so a small ID-I difference without a placebo arm cannot be interpreted.
   - The OfficeQA follow-up (3.0M tokens on at most 74 items, detectable effect about 12-17 points) is nearly uninformative.

8. Claim: "ExpeL ... the closest precedent for offline insight extraction".
   - The citation is correct: AAAI 2024, 38(17):19632-19642.
   - Closer QA precedents were missed:
     - LEAP (Zhang et al., ICML 2024, arXiv 2402.05403) distils principles offline from the model's own mistakes. Over few-shot CoT it gains up to about +3.5 on HotpotQA (multi-hop QA, like SearchQA) and +7.5 on DROP (numerical reading, like OfficeQA) with GPT-4, smaller gains for other models, and it does worse than the baseline with Gemini Pro on HotpotQA.
     - MetaReflection (EMNLP 2024): offline instructions from reflections, +4 to +16.8% over raw GPT-4.
     - ACE (arXiv 2510.04618): offline system-prompt adaptation, +8.6% on finance tasks.
     - Training-Free GRPO (arXiv 2510.08191): multi-epoch experiential knowledge with DeepSeek-V3.1 on math and web search.
   - These works use multi-epoch, incremental curation, and none has a hand-written card baseline. E8's single-pass, single-draw result speaks only to that weaker procedure.

  - OfficeQA I: 35/134 -> 34/67 (20/3, median 10 -> 267).

- Rules:
  - 15 proposed, 1 dropped (8-gram leak), 14 kept.
  - Claimed condition share: median 50% (range 20-95%). "Covered: none" on 11/14.
  - Containment medians: card 0.052, seeds 0.128, v3 proposals 0.355 (max 0.657).
  - The two OfficeQA folds share 4/5 themes (Jaccard 0.22-0.36, against 0.02 between unrelated rules).
- The card-metric reading is fair. The SearchQA card (skillopt/coevo5/texts.py) says the text inside the last <answer> tag is compared and "anything else in the reply is ignored". It lacks OfficeQA's explicit "no tag = wrong", but the scorer's last-line fallback (evaluator.py lines 28-39) contradicts the card.
- The detectable-effect arithmetic (2.8 x SD / sqrt(n)) is correct.
- Pre-registration: design.json was written 00:05:14 and the amendment 00:11:45, before any OfficeQA cell; the SearchQA cells start at 00:10:13.
- Hard rules: the inventory script filtered names and partition labels before opening any file, and only the development and skill_confirmation partitions appear. I found no violation.
- Recommendations 1, 4 and 6 are supported: keep the card as the start; fix or report the tag fallback; OfficeQA's 74 items cannot resolve effects below about 15 points.
missing:
1. The decisive arm, card + rules (ID) against the card (I), with enough power.
   - Design: 250-300 fresh SearchQA items (300 remain outside v3's draw and E8's evaluation), 1 run each (instructed arms flip on only 1/100 items between runs), a length-matched placebo-on-card arm, all interleaved.
   - Cost: about 3.4-4.1M tokens.
   - Even then, the detectable effect is about 3.5-4 points, at or above D9's 0-3-point headroom, so an inconclusive result is likely. Say so up front.
   - Drop the OfficeQA follow-up.
2. Serving-mode handling.
   - Record the bare share per cell.
   - Re-test in a terse session if one recurs.
   - Or add a format-pinned D (D + the card's answer-format bullets) to separate format effects from content effects.
3. Purpose 2 test: place the SearchQA-distilled rules where they apply to OfficeQA (a registered similar pair), plus a harm check on LiveMath (dissimilar).
4. Purpose 1: no verifier or rubric component at all.
   - Natural links: the proposed tag-rate and verbosity guard as an executable rubric check.
   - Archive failure families (calendar vs fiscal year, cumulative tables) as specifications for generated items (D6).
5. Distiller variance: several draws per job, a distiller shown the seeds, and a per-rule ablation (e.g. OA5).
6. Literature: LEAP, MetaReflection, ACE (offline), Training-Free GRPO.
notes_cn:
复核结论：E8 的数字全部能复现，主结论在它测过的范围内成立；但标题"不值得做"说过了头，有几处解释是错的。

1. 数字核对：我从 801 条原始作答记录重新统计了一遍，结果和报告一致。核对过的内容有：
- SearchQA（搜索问答）和 OfficeQA（财政公报表格问答）各组的答对数、差值和置信区间（真实差值大概率落在的范围）；
- 不写答案标签的次数；
- 两折交叉（用一半题提炼出的规则，只在另一半题上测）是否真的分开；
- 总花费 3,021,746 个 token（模型计算文字量的单位）。
代码和 v3 冻结版本逐字节相同，也没有发现读取测试题之类的违规。这次复核没有花钱调用模型。

2. E8 测的是"用提炼出的规则替换任务卡"，不是"在任务卡上再加规则"。负责人关心的是学到的规则能不能胜过一份好的说明，对应的实验是"任务卡加规则"对"任务卡"，这个实验只写好了脚本，没有跑。所以证据只能说明"提炼出的规则替代不了任务卡"，说明不了"热启动不值得做"。

3. "答题模型变了，旧记录已经过期"这个说法不对。D5 方向的结果和我按时间重查 v3 记录都显示，同一个接口在两种状态之间来回切换：一种是"简短模式"，只给答案标签；一种是"详细模式"，先写过程再给答案。具体时间：
- 10 月 19 日 23:20：详细模式；
- 20 日 0:00 到 1:15：简短模式；
- 1:30 到 2:00：详细模式；
- 2:17 到 6:30：简短模式；
- 下午起直到 E8 运行时：详细模式。
所以简短模式并没有消失，随时可能再出现；这也不是新发现，D5 已经报告过。对策应该是"同一时段内交错比较，每条记录标明当时是哪种模式"，而不是"在同一周内重测"。

4. E8 自己的结果也受这两种模式影响，而它全程只测到了详细模式。
- SearchQA：在详细模式下，不加规则的空白模板有 29/200 次不写答案标签；同一模板在 v3 的简短模式下只有 4/400 次。按任务卡的规则（只认标签里的答案），D 比任务卡低 13.5 个百分点，主要原因就是详细模式下空白模板不写标签，不是规则本身有害。
- OfficeQA：规则让模型只写答案、不写计算过程，所以变差。但在简短模式下，三组本来就都只写答案，差距可能缩小。
因此"D 比任务卡差"这个结论只对详细模式成立。

5. 和负责人目的的对应：
- E8 完全没有涉及验证端（评分细则）的进化；
- 也没有做"在一个数据集上进化、在其他数据集上评测"：每个数据集的规则只在本数据集上测过；
- 报告里关于跨数据集的说法是推断，没有实测。

6. 有一条建议站不住："把 v3 提过的规则思路列为'已经试过、不要再提'"。v3 的规则没通过，大多是因为题目太少、噪声太大，测不出效果；和 E8 规则最接近的 14 条里，有 4 条在 v3 根本没被测过（证据格式不合格，直接作废了）。没通过不等于没用，不应该把它们拉黑。

7. 准备好的后续实验设计偏弱。
- 它只用原来那 100 道题，也没有安慰剂对照。安慰剂对照指与任务无关、长度相当的一段文字；在 cal-1 实验里，单是这种文字就能让分数变动 −9.8 到 +3.6 个百分点。
- D9 估计任务卡之上只剩 0–3 个百分点的提升空间，100 道题测不出这么小的差别。
- 如果要跑：换 250–300 道新题，每题答 1 遍，加一组安慰剂，约 340–410 万 token。即便这样，能测出的最小差别也有 3.5–4 个百分点，结果很可能仍然分不出高低。
- OfficeQA 只有 74 道训练题，它的后续实验应该取消。

8. 文献：ExpeL 的出处核对无误，但漏掉了更接近的工作：
- LEAP（2024 年 ICML 会议）：从模型自己做错的题里离线提炼原则。比给几道例题的做法，在多跳问答上最多高约 3.5 个百分点，在数字阅读题上最多高约 7.5 个百分点；换别的模型时增益更小，有时反而更差。
- MetaReflection（2024 年 EMNLP 会议）。
- 2025 年的 ACE 和 Training-Free GRPO：它们都是多轮反复整理经验。
E8 只提炼了一次，结论只适用于这种做法。

可行性仍判为"低"。提炼本身很便宜，约 20 万 token；但按现有证据，提炼出的规则替代不了任务卡，加在任务卡之上的提升预计小于目前能测出的幅度。
